summary: Verified the 3 bug-fixes on /our-work/craft-livelihood?edit=1 (and regression on /about?edit=1). FIX1 (no reflow / no overlap): PASS — `main` width stays at 1920px in both edit and plain modes (identical), hero heading and grey intro band render identically. body padding-right reflow is gone. FIX1b (draggable panel): PASS — dragging the `live-panel-drag` grip relocates the whole panel; it moved from (top=12, left=1608) to (top=375, left=375). FIX2 (real responsive preview): PASS — clicking `live-device-mobile` opens `live-preview-overlay` with an `live-preview-frame` iframe exactly 375px wide; inside the iframe `window.innerWidth=375`, the MENU hamburger is visible and content stacks in a single column (real mobile layout, not squished desktop). `live-device-tablet` → iframe 768px. `live-preview-close` (Back to editing) closes the overlay. FIX3 (section background LIVE): PASS — setting `live-sec-bg` to #ffd400 immediately applied `backgroundColor: rgb(255,212,0)` to the selected section wrapper (`main [data-sec] .hb-bg`) BEFORE save, inner `<section>` was neutralized to transparent (rgba(0,0,0,0)) so the colour is visible. Class `hb-bg` is added live. `live-sec-bg-clear` reverts live. Regression: add-section (`live-add-section` → `live-add-text`) inserts live (8→9), Save (`live-save-btn`) PUT /api/admin/pages/about/live returns 200, success toast 'Saved — your changes are now live on the public page' is now visible, change persists on plain /about reload. Font-size regression: `live-font-size`=64 → computed font-size changes live to 64px (inline is now `font-size: 64px !important` — the earlier iteration_1 critical bug is also fixed). Anonymous visitor sees no editor UI with or without ?edit=1.

issues: Minor UX: once the mobile/tablet preview overlay is open, `.live-preview-stage` fully covers the right-side editor panel so the `live-device-desktop` button inside the panel is pointer-intercepted by the overlay. Users must use the `Back to editing` (`live-preview-close`) button in the top bar — which works. Spec says 'live-device-desktop closes any preview'; functionally the device toggle buttons are unreachable while an overlay is open. Non-blocking since Back-to-editing exists.
The hero of /our-work/craft-livelihood renders the top site header on top of the hero image area; purely visual, unrelated to this fix.

action_items: Optional UX polish: either raise z-index of `.live-panel` above `.live-preview-overlay`, or hide the device-toggle group in the overlay bar so users don't try to click an unreachable desktop button. Not a blocker — `Back to editing` works.
critical_code_review_comments: LiveEditor.jsx is still ~390 LOC in a single file with heavy single-line JSX; consider splitting into PanelHeader/TextControls/SectionStyle/AddMenu/PreviewOverlay for maintainability. (Carry-over from iteration_1.)

`previewSrc = window.location.pathname` snapshots only the pathname at mount; the iframe always loads the SAVED version of the current page — matches the known/acceptable limitation called out by the main agent. Consider either noting this inline or passing `?preview=1` so the iframe hides the editor toggle inside itself (it already hides because site.live_editor_enabled check + ?edit absent).

`dragPanel()` writes `pos` only on move; initial position before drag relies on CSS right-anchoring. On very small viewports a user could drag the panel partially off-screen bottom — clamping is only `top: innerHeight-44`, acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 3 bug-fixes verified; all regression flows pass)

seed_data_creation: Added one text section to /about during Save+persist regression test. Per main-agent note, DB will be restored from the pages collection dump — no cleanup performed by this agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three reported bugs are fixed and verified live on https://usp-india-cms.preview.emergentagent.com/our-work/craft-livelihood?edit=1 and /about?edit=1. Important Playwright tip: HTML color inputs do NOT fire React onChange when you do `fs.fill()` or raw `dispatchEvent('input')` on them. Use the native setter trick: `const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; setter.call(el, '#ffd400'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}))` to get React to pick up the value. Similarly for numeric inputs when fill() blurs the field and triggers remount. Toaster is now reachable (confirmed success toast after save). z-index conflict with sticky header from iteration_1 appears resolved as well (Save worked via JS click; direct click should also work now). Only minor remaining UX gap: device-toggle buttons on the panel are not clickable while the mobile/tablet preview overlay is open — users exit via Back-to-editing.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all three reported bugs are fixed. Original RCAs: (1) `body.live-editing main { padding-right:300px }` and `.live-dev-*` main-width rules in index.css were causing the reflow — now removed. (2) old device-preview was CSS-scaling the real main instead of using an iframe — now a true overlay+iframe at live-frame-mobile(375px)/live-frame-tablet(768px) renders a genuine responsive layout. (3) section bg wasn't visible because the inner `<section>` had its own background fill; new rule `.hb-bg > section { background: transparent !important }` plus Block applying `styles._section` to the wrapper with class `hb-bg` makes the picked colour show through immediately on every onChange of `live-sec-bg`.
